label: Claude Cowork — Home screen
description: The Claude desktop Home/Cowork screen (built from actual screenshots): white sidebar with Home tab active (New / Projects / Artifacts / Scheduled / Dispatch / Customize, Pinned + numbered Recents, Design row, account), and the centered hero -- serif greeting with the orange ✳ ('Afternoon, Marc'), the big composer card ('How can I help you today?') with +, Chat/Cowork toggle, model picker (Opus 4.8 High) and mic, the 'Project or folder / Manual / 2× more usage' sub-row, and 'Ideas for you' rows. SCRIPTED performable surface. Camera anchors: composer, ideas, sidebar.

prompt_text.label: SHORTHAND: types into the composer then sends (working ✳ appears)

usage_label.label: Right side of the sub-row (default '2× more usage until August 5')

ideas.label: 'Ideas for you' rows: [{icon: '🌅', label: 'Send me a daily briefing'}]

script.label: Actions: type-prompt {text} (types into the composer), send-prompt (clears + shows the orange ✳ working under the card), working {text?} / stop-working, switch-mode {mode: 'chat'|'cowork'} (toggle flips), choose-idea {index} (an idea row highlights). Plus base actions (move-cursor, click, wait). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (composer, ideas, sidebar).

script_actions.description: Clear the composer and show the orange ✳ working line beneath it
